statBlock.name: Gelatinous Cube
statBlock.description: A nearly clear ooze creeps through dungeon corridors, digesting creatures while their belongings drift inside it.

sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone.
sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft. It is blind beyond that radius. Passive Perception 8.
sections.Traits:
Ooze Cube. The cube fills its entire space. A creature that enters it is subject to Engulf and rolls the save with disadvantage. Creatures inside are visible and have total cover. A creature within 5 ft. can spend an action to pull a creature or object out. The creature attempting the rescue takes 10 (3d6) acid damage and needs a DC 12 Strength check to succeed. The cube holds one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures at a time.
Transparent. A cube that has neither moved nor attacked takes a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to notice even in plain sight. A creature that tries to enter its space without noticing it is surprised by the cube.
sections.Actions:
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 10 (3d6) acid damage.
Engulf. The cube moves up to its speed and can enter the spaces of Large or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space it enters makes a DC 12 Dexterity save. On success, the creature may be pushed 5 ft. back or to the side of the cube. Declining the push counts as a failed save. On failure, the cube enters its space, deals 10 (3d6) acid damage, and engulfs it. The victim is Restrained, cannot breathe, and moves with the cube. It takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of the cube's turns. It can use an action to make a DC 12 Strength check. On success it moves into a space it chooses within 5 ft. of the cube.

statBlock.name: Rust Monster
statBlock.description: An armored scavenger follows the scent of iron and steel. Loose metal can draw it away from the party.

sections.Traits:
Iron Scent. It can locate ferrous metal by smell within 30 ft.
Rust Metal. A hit with a nonmagical metal weapon deals its damage before the weapon takes a permanent, cumulative −1 to damage rolls. The weapon breaks at −5. Nonmagical metal ammunition is destroyed immediately after dealing damage.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.
Antennae. Touch one visible nonmagical ferrous metal object within 5 ft. If unattended, a 1-ft. cube of the object is destroyed. A creature wearing or carrying it can avoid contact with a DC 11 Dexterity save. Touched armor and shields take a permanent, cumulative −1 to the AC they provide. Armor breaks when reduced to AC 10 and a shield breaks when its bonus reaches +0. A held metal weapon corrodes as in Rust Metal.

statBlock.name: Hook Horror
statBlock.description: Underdark hunting packs scale cavern walls and signal to one another by clacking their hooks against stone.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 10 ft. Passive Perception 13.
sections.Traits:
Echolocation. Being Deafened shuts off its blindsight.
Keen Hearing. Roll Wisdom (Perception) checks based on hearing with advantage.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Hook attacks.
Hook. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) piercing damage.

statBlock.name: Helmed Horror
statBlock.description: An empty suit of plate follows the purpose behind its creator's orders. In battle it flies to reach weaker opponents and spellcasters.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons unless they are adamantine.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Stunned.
sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft. It is blind beyond that radius. Passive Perception 14.
sections.Languages: Understands its creator's languages and cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Magic Resistance. Roll saves against spells and other magical effects with advantage.
Spell Immunity. The creator chooses three spells to which the construct is immune. Fireball, heat metal, and lightning bolt are typical choices.
Constructed Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Longsword attacks.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) slashing damage with one hand or 9 (1d10 + 4) slashing damage with two.

statBlock.name: Galeb Duhr
statBlock.speed: 15 ft., 30 ft. when rolling, 60 ft. when rolling downhill
statBlock.description: A living boulder keeps watch over isolated rocky sites. It can set nearby stones rolling against intruders.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons.
sections.Senses: Darkvision 60 ft., tremorsense 60 ft. Passive Perception 11.
sections.Traits:
False Appearance. While motionless, it passes for an ordinary boulder.
Rolling Charge. After rolling at least 20 ft. straight toward a target, a Slam hit against it on the same turn deals an extra 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage. A creature hit this way also makes a DC 16 Strength save or falls Prone.
Stone Guardian. It does not age or need sustenance. When it dies, it remains bound to the Material Plane.
sections.Actions:
Slam. Melee weapon attack, +8 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning damage.
Animate Boulders (1/day). Choose up to two visible boulders within 60 ft. Each uses the galeb duhr's statistics with Intelligence and Charisma 1. The boulders cannot be Charmed or Frightened, and they cannot use Animate Boulders. They stay animated while the galeb duhr maintains Concentration as on a spell, up to 1 minute.

statBlock.name: Crawling Claw
statBlock.description: Dark magic leaves a severed hand free to crawl and strike. It follows simple commands and can feel for a key or doorknob.

sections.Senses: Blindsight 30 ft. It is blind beyond that radius. Passive Perception 10.
sections.Traits:
Turn Immunity. Effects that turn undead do not affect the claw.
Creator's Control. Spells that control undead do not control the claw. Its creator can concentrate on it while it is in sight to direct its actions mentally. Without new directions it keeps following its last command. It can follow simple orders but cannot track and single out a specified person.
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Living Claw. If the creature whose hand was animated still lives, the claw can rejoin that creature's arm. On separating again, the creature falls into a coma. Destroying the detached claw kills that creature. Killing the creature has no effect on the claw.
sections.Actions: Claw. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning or slashing damage, chosen by the claw.

statBlock.name: Scarecrow
statBlock.description: A bound spirit keeps vigil in a straw body, holding still until an intruder comes close enough to see its face.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Unconscious.
sections.Languages: Understands its creator's languages and cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
False Appearance. While motionless, it passes for an ordinary scarecrow.
Construct Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (2d4 + 1) slashing damage. A creature hit must also make a DC 11 Wisdom save or become Frightened through the end of the scarecrow's next turn.
Terrifying Glare. Choose one creature the scarecrow can see within 30 ft. If the creature can also see the scarecrow, it makes a DC 11 Wisdom save. On failure it is magically Frightened through the end of the scarecrow's next turn and Paralyzed while Frightened by this glare.
